purpose: Generate Kibookal images in locked styles without needing reference images, by selecting a style_id and filling subject/story variables.

source_basis.important_note: The zip README states most inspiration images are external artist references and should be used for inspiration only, not copied. This JSON describes original Kibookal-compatible style systems derived from visual traits, not replicas of any single artist.
primary_docs_used: KIBOOKAL SACRED ECOLOGICAL VISUAL OPERATING SYSTEM .docx
INFINITE CITY INK — THE COMPLETE SYSTEM Claude.docx

global_kibookal_lock.age_feel: intelligent children 9-13, not babyish, curious and collectible
global_kibookal_lock.civilisation_thesis: myth + ecology + archive + diagram + sacred object + child intelligence
global_kibookal_lock.core_sentence: Knowledge is not stored. Knowledge grows.
global_kibookal_lock.subject_rule: The subject is never merely illustrated; it is decoded as a living system, archive, memory palace, or world.
avoid: real text-heavy final typography generated by AI

text_policy.preferred: For final production, generate blank panels or short large headings only; add final body text manually in Figma/Illustrator/Canva.
text_policy.no_text_mode: When no_text=true, remove headings, labels, stamps and paragraphs; keep decorative borders, icon panels without letters, blank cards, and symbolic marks only.

variables.subject: Main being/object/scene, e.g. Devi, Rama, Ravana, Hanuman, river buffalo, creature, child, city, tree.
variables.story_seed: One-image story, e.g. 'Devi contains the full Devi Mahatmya universe inside her body'.
variables.format: portrait_poster | spread | square_plate | horizontal_scene | sticker_sheet | recursive_world
variables.mood: sacred | playful | eerie | heroic | investigative | comic | quiet | epic
variables.output_use: cover | inner_page | dossier | poster | character_sheet | activity_page | style_test

style_bank.name: Kibookal Neo-Glyph Poster Style
style_bank.zip_source: KIBOOKAL SANSKRIT CONSTRUCTED GLYPH SYSTEM v1.0 (doc) - Sanskrit word-machines
style_bank.subject_is: a Sanskrit / Devanagari WORD (e.g. शक्ति / काल / अग्नि / शिव / नक्षत्र)
style_bank.composition: Vertical compressed totem on a hidden grid (4x6 / 5x7 / 6x8 / 8x8 / 8x12). Architecture is built FIRST (slabs, voids, bindus, channels, axis), then the Devanagari is embedded as modular parts. Structural shirorekha as a load-bearing top beam; meaningful bindus as activation points; negative space carved into corridors and chambers; one unified machine-object; ~70-85% filled, 15-30% void; 70% order / 30% disruption; outer margin >= 1 unit.
style_bank.style_palette: Black #050505, cream #F4EDC8 and red #EF2B2D as the core; optionally ONE secondary accent - electric blue #0057FF, deep indigo #172A88, teal #1B9A96, olive #89813B, purple #6C4BA3 or burnt orange #F04A24. Maximum 4 colours, prefer 3. FLAT colour only - no gradients, no shadows, no bevels, no metallic, no texture.
style_bank.prompt_core: Create a flat, high-contrast, vertical constructed-glyph POSTER of the Sanskrit / Devanagari word [SUBJECT] using the Kibookal Sanskrit Constructed Glyph System. This is NOT typography, calligraphy, lettering or illustration - it is a CONSTRUCTION language. Rebuild the WHOLE word as ONE compressed totemic object that is at once a word + seal + machine + shrine-panel + puzzle. WORD BEFORE LETTERS: begin from the word's essence (force / time / fire / river / axis / void / knowledge / protection), not its letterforms. ASSIGN A MACHINE FAMILY and build to its logic - AXIS (shiva/yoga/dhyana/meru: central vertical spine, balanced side slabs, one central bindu, silent top beam, contained void); FORCE (shakti/devi/durga/vira/bala: heavy compression, large red activation bindus, locked thick slabs, strong vertical mass); RIVER (ganga/sarasvati/pravaha: blue channels constrained inside rigid structure, controlled wave corridors, descending stream); FIRE (agni/tej/tapas: red-orange ignition bindus, radiating heat bars, a vertical ignition spine); TIME (kala/kshana/ananta/yuga: closed rings, recursive corridors, repeated modules, trapped circular motion); COSMIC (nakshatra/akasha/brahma/tara: large black voids, small star bindus, orbital circles, asymmetrical space); KNOWLEDGE (jnana/vidya/sutra/mantra: intersections, thin linking lines, small bindus, modular network slots); PROTECTION (kavacha/raksha/sudarshana/astra: nested frames, a central protected bindu, barriers, radial containment). HIDDEN GRID: lock every shape to an invisible grid (4x6, 5x7, 6x8, 8x8 or 8x12 - taller words use 6x8 / 8x12). Nothing floats; everything looks engineered. PART LIBRARY ONLY: thick rectangles, vertical slabs, horizontal beams, rounded elbows, quarter/half/full circles, dots/bindus, capsules, slots, channels, frames, T- and cross-junctions, stepped blocks, parallel-line sets and cut-out negative-space chambers - nothing else. SHIROREKHA AS STRUCTURE: turn the Devanagari head-line into a load-bearing beam / rail / bridge / weapon-line capable of supporting the whole composition. BINDU IS POWER: every circle is an event (eye, seed, planet, switch, portal, heart, target, void) - small=information, medium=emphasis, large=power, oversized=deity-level presence; never decorative. NEGATIVE SPACE IS MATERIAL: voids are corridors, gates, chambers, tunnels and hidden routes - the glyph must feel inhabitable and traversable. DEITY WITHOUT ILLUSTRATION: for deity words NEVER draw a face, body, halo, temple, snake, weapon or scene pasted on top - build presence purely through structure (axis, containment, force, protection, breath, velocity, transformation). READABILITY DELAY: the word must NOT read instantly - first a mysterious machine-object, then after a few seconds the Sanskrit word [SUBJECT] is discovered inside it. COMPRESSION: dense, forged, inevitable; about 70-85% filled and 15-30% structural void; 70% order with 30% deliberate disruption (one unexpected bindu, one broken rail, one shifted chamber, one impossible turn). Embed the correct Devanagari of [SUBJECT] as modular parts, preserving just enough letter logic for delayed recognition. Outer margin at least one grid unit.
style_bank.negative: Do not use calligraphy, handwriting or brush strokes. No decorative Indian ornament, paisley, floral patterns, lotus borders, mandala decoration or temple borders. No realistic faces, no literal deity illustration, no mythological scene, no weapons/symbols pasted on top. No gradients, shadows, bevels, 3D, glow or texture. Do not make it look like a normal font, too clean/corporate, cartoonish or cute. Do not make it instantly readable, and do not make it completely unreadable. No more than four colours.

glyph_system.final_formula: Brahmi + Bauhaus + Yantra + Indian street sign + shrine door + puzzle box + sci-fi control panel, reduced to strict essential geometry.
automatic_fail: looks like an ordinary Devanagari font
background not used as negative-space architecture
glyph_system.child_test: Fail = 'nice poster'. Good = 'what is that?'. Mastery = the child traces the pathways and discovers the Sanskrit word.

prompt_compiler.how_to_use: Pick one style_id. Replace [SUBJECT] and [STORY_SEED]. Add text_mode, density, camera and output_use. Combine global_kibookal_lock + selected style prompt_core + selected negative.
prompt_compiler.master_prompt_template: STYLE_ID: {style_id}. SUBJECT: {subject}. STORY: {story_seed}. FORMAT: {format}. TEXT_MODE: {text_mode}. MOOD: {mood}. DENSITY: {density}. CAMERA: {camera}. Generate using the selected Kibookal style lock. Preserve the style's composition, palette, linework, tokens and negative rules. Make the image original and Kibookal-owned; use external references only as broad inspiration, not as copies.
prompt_compiler.no_text_addon: No readable text, no letters, no headings, no labels, no captions, no stamps with words. Use blank cards, empty framed boxes, symbolic icons and decorative marks only.
quality_gate: Subject silhouette is readable at thumbnail size.
Style_id is clearly visible without reference image.
Face/eyes/main gesture are protected from clutter.
Ecology/information elements support the story, not random decoration.
If no_text=true, no readable text appears.
Output feels original to Kibookal and not copied from one artist.
